class.name: HTMLDialogCloseRequest
class.brief_description: A synchronous request to close an HTML dialog.
class.description: Emitted by [signal HTMLDialogElement.close_requested]. Connect directly to the signal and call [method prevent_default] during the callback to keep the dialog open.

method.name: is_default_prevented
method.description: Returns whether a listener canceled this request.

method.name: prevent_default
method.description: Cancels the default close action during synchronous signal delivery. Deferred calls have no effect.

members.member: The source of this close request.
The proposed result. A [code]null[/code] value preserves [member HTMLDialogElement.return_value].

constants.constant: A press of the Escape key.
A primary pointer click outside the active dialog.
